scope: Exactly one bounded endpoint003 pass on the immutable original head; no automatic follow-up or retry

geometry_policy.reference: Exactly original immutable in_patch faces, in original face order; CGAL face_range constructor.
geometry_policy.patch_seed_rule: Unchanged triangle_SICN < 2/29, then original faces incident to any original seed vertex; no recursive expansion, halo, boxes, transforms or candidate reference.
geometry_policy.proof: P subset S implies distance(x,S) <= distance(x,P); patch-envelope containment is a stricter sufficient candidate-to-original screen, not original-to-candidate coverage.
geometry_policy.unchanged_policy: All endpoint-only, fixed/exterior, zero-length, whole-fan normal/positive-quality/local-improvement, topology and postconditions preserved.
geometry_policy.remaining_storage: Full original and candidate Surface_mesh graphs plus global SMS queue remain. Memory success and previous OOM allocation stage are unknown.

report_expectations.native_log_format: JSONL progress records followed by a final JSON report. Consume head-endpoint003/report.json separately; the complete native log is not a single report.
report_expectations.source_coordinate_origins: Every output vertex coordinate must equal its recorded original indexed coordinate; the map is not full ancestry for removed vertices.

stop_and_failure: One bounded request, no retry, escalation, fallback, smoothing, transform, added patch or geometry regeneration. Preserve partial, stagnated, OOM, deadline, setup and cleanup outcomes. The frozen helper kills/reaps verified owned processes and removes only stopped owned containers. Uncertain cleanup is a refusal.

resource_scope.source_soft_alarm_scope: Starts immediately before SMS; the external controller bounds the whole invocation to 300 seconds.

independent_distance_scope: The unchanged 0.0625 mm original-patch envelope is only a conservative local candidate-to-original screen. Both completed full-original directed CUB intervals remain required at upper <=0.0625 mm and gap <=0.0001 mm, with recomputed exact shared-facet reduction and complete opposite distance targets. ID exports or vertex sampling do not establish that gate.
fixture_evidence_scope: Four completed synthetic software fixtures and both retained-output reviews are bound exactly; they do not establish head memory success, head distance, accepted head surface, volume quality or physics.
projection: Original allowlisted authorization, controls, assumptions and future acceptance requirements. These are pre-run requirements, not completed gates. Commands, arguments, native mount paths and preparation path omitted.

source_attribution.scope: The phase controller captures itself, the frozen metadata companion and the frozen cleanup core. Old head002 controller/source pins retain historical failed evidence and are not the active controller.

input_surface.frame: Original coordinates in millimetres; no transform.

reviews.head_recipe_root_review: CLEAR: full exact recipe and all142 current pins
reviews.head_recipe_independent_review: CLEAR: historical_reference exact held recipe, source, controls and all142 current pins
